dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: We need strong government intervention to ensure quality care for everyone, not a free-for-all where only the wealthy get the best treatment. Market forces alone can’t be trusted to prioritise public health over profit, so we need strong government oversight to keep costs down and quality up. I reckon letting market forces dominate healthcare will just widen inequality, leaving the poorest without proper care while profits soar for a few. How can you justify limiting state involvement when private sector innovation often prioritises profit over equal access for the most vulnerable? Plus, look at the NHS—despite its flaws, it’s a system that cuts long-term costs by focusing on prevention, something private firms rarely care about.
